judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving two of its own facets unchecked and committing `.lore/dod.md` and `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` into the repo. Functionally, it compiles `ToolDefinitionSource` only once at `register` time rather than resolving function-valued definitions per `execute` call and caching by schema reference via `WeakMap`, violating a core requirement. It also fails to log validation rejections (`log.warn`), omits the required one-line JSDoc on `execute`, and misses several required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` (such as extra properties passing through, dynamic schema resolution, and unknown tool throwing). Finally, it completely omits the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, while leaving an incomplete entry in `CHANGELOG.md`.
